claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.
- A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.
- European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.
- Deaths confirmed in major fire at Canada military base: Number of casualties unknown in "very, very active and delicate" situation in Alberta, says defence minister.
- Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.
- Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.
- At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.
- Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.
- Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.
- Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery: The pontiff will give the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing in St Peter's Square on Sunday.
- Actress Selma Blair says she 'did not intend to harm anyone' in plane altercation: A publicist for the actress said the incident stemmed from a "medical emergency" and said she has a neurological disorder that can cause out-of-control responses.
- Judge throws out child sex abuse charges against actor Timothy Busfield: The judge in the case said on Friday that the prosecutor "failed to act in a fair and impartial manner".
